title: TOTP guard: one enrollment per person, codes accepted once
spec: Implement TotpGuard as its doc comments say, on crewcraft_totp::Totp (Totp::with_defaults, Totp::verify with SKEW_STEPS and the stored last_used counter). The Debug impl stays. Delete the `#[allow(clippy::todo)]` on the impl and the `_fields` helper at the bottom (it only keeps the stub free of dead-code warnings). The `crewcraft-totp` dependency is already added to the crate. No other new dependencies.
